DOP: bhuvādi bhūvādi mfn. [ cf S. bhūvādi], ( gr.t.t. ) beginning with √bhū; 1. a term for all verbal roots ( cf Pāṇ 1:3:1); Sadd 2, 20 (bhuvādayo saddā dhātavo, Ee so; Be bhūvādayo); 825, 30 (bhuvādayo dhātavo: bhū icc evamādayo ye saddagaṇā te dhātusaññā honti, Ee so ); — 2. the series of roots beginning with √bhū (bhū̆vādigaṇa); Sadd 824, 16 (bhuvādito a: bhū icc evamādito dhātugaṇato apaccayo kattari bhavati pacati icc adi); — °- gaṇa , m. , the series of roots beginning with √bhū; Sadd 2, 22 (~o rudhādigaṇo …, Ee so; Be bhūvādi-); 3, 12 (~ato apaccayo hoti kattari, Ee so; Be bhūvādi-); 328, 10 (te imasmiṃ ~e vuttā, Ee so; Be bhūvādi-); — °- gaṇika , mfn. , belonging to the series of roots beginning with √bhū; Sadd 328, 21 (~aṃ akammakaṃ …, Ee so; Be bhūvādi-); 388, 8 (dvigaṇiko vadadhātu ~o ca curādigaṇiko ca, Ee so; Be bhūvādi-).
